definitions.explanation: An example showing how a word, phrase, expression, or tool is actually used. Common in dictionaries, grammar references, and technical documentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な{用例|ようれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: The dictionary contains abundant usage examples.

examples.japanese: {用例|ようれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you look at the usage examples, you can easily understand how to use it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}→文法書：29307_bunpousho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{用例|ようれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧にくい。
examples.english: This grammar book has few usage examples, so it's hard to understand how the items are actually used.

notes:
USAGE:
{用例|ようれい} refers specifically to examples that demonstrate how something is used in practice. Most commonly found in discussions about dictionaries, language learning materials, and technical documentation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {用例|ようれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (show usage examples)
- {用例|ようれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (collect usage examples)
- ⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な{用例|ようれい} (abundant examples)
- {用例|ようれい}⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧ (example search)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{例文|れいぶん}→例文：19450_reibun⟧: example sentence (specifically a sentence, often in language study)
- ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧: example (general, broader)
- ⟦{実例|じつれい}→実例：04217_jitsurei⟧: actual example, real-world case (emphasis on being from real situations)
